{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted long-sleeve base top, close fit, hip length, ivory (#EDE6DA), fine merino wool
Refined turtleneck sweater, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, deep burgundy (#6D2B3A), merino wool
Tailored trousers, straight leg, full length just touching the top of the boot, charcoal (#3A3D42), wool-blend twill
Long coat, single-breasted with a storm flap, mid-calf length, dark navy (#1F2430), dense wool blend with a warm insulated lining
Ankle boots, low block heel, deep-lugged rubber sole, dark brown (#4A2F25), water-repellent leather
Thick socks, crew length, grey (#4B4E54), merino wool
Beanie, snug fit, charcoal grey (#8A8D91), knit wool with a fleece lining
Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, camel (#B58A5A), soft wool
Gloves, full length to the wrist, black (#1A1A1A), leather with a cashmere lining

This outfit keeps the neat business look: a refined knit with tailored trousers and ankle boots. Thin layers under a long insulated coat, plus a hat, scarf and gloves, keep you warm for 20 minutes on foot in deep frost. The water-repellent boots with a grippy sole handle snow and road salt, and the full-length trousers keep the salt off your ankles. The burgundy and camel add warmth against the dark, quiet base colors, so you arrive at work looking put together."}
